ignore_dirs.description: Absolute or relative paths to ignore, comma-separated list

ignore_dirs_pattern.description: Path patterns (regex) to ignore, comma-separated list

max_cores.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to use

show_apparent_size.description: Show apparent size instead of disk usage

show_item_count.description: Show number of items in directory (non-interactive mode)

show_mtime.description: Show latest mtime of items in directory (non-interactive mode)

si.description: Use decimal SI prefixes instead of binary prefixes

no_unicode.description: Disable Unicode symbols for size bar

max_age.description: Include files with mtime no older than DURATION (e.g., 7d, 2h30m)

min_age.description: Include files with mtime at least DURATION old (e.g., 30d, 1w)

interactive.description: Force interactive mode even when output is not a TTY

read_from_storage.description: Use existing database instead of re-scanning

reverse_sort.description: Reverse sorting order (smallest to largest) in non-interactive mode

sorting_by.description: Default sort field: size, name, itemCount, or mtime

sorting_order.description: Sort order: desc (largest first) or asc (smallest first)
